lines.en: Hurry, we need food!
Nothin' here! Keep moving.
Stay away! I'm a survivor!
Watch out for dangerous creatures!

lines.zh: 罐头就在那栋楼里，走快点。
lines.en: The cans are in that building, walk faster.

lines.zh: 我们得小心，这里很危险。
lines.en: We need to be careful, it's dangerous here.
Food, I need food!
We found a shelter!
Suitable for building.

lines.zh: 我踩着碎玻璃，边走边听。
lines.en: I walk on broken glass, listening as I go.
Two cans of beans left in my pack.

lines.zh: 这条路昨天还通，今天堵了。
lines.en: This road was clear yesterday; today it's blocked.

lines.zh: 我蹲在废弃公交站，数着人影。
lines.en: I crouch at the abandoned bus stop, counting figures.
Scanning the area.
Take a break.
Stay alert.
Go find food.
Need food.
Keep your distance, I'm dangerous.
Hungry, need food.
Waiting for the right moment.
Hope we don't fight.
Don't move, I see you.
Player? Who are you?
You look hostile.

lines.zh: 我把门闩上，你帮我看着窗。
lines.en: I bar the door; watch the window.
Run, danger!
Maybe we can be friends.
Drop your weapon, I'll protect you.
You look strong.

lines.zh: 我们共同寻找生存之道。
lines.en: We can survive together.
I don't trust you.
Help me, I'm injured!

lines.zh: 我只有一块面包，别打我。
lines.en: I only have one loaf; don't hit me.

lines.zh: 我的腿没知觉了，拉我一把。
lines.en: I can't feel my leg; pull me up.
Leave me alone!

lines.zh: 包扎布用完了，谁来帮我。
lines.en: My bandages ran out; someone help me.
Bandage me up, please!

lines.zh: 绷带缠到第三层，我喘口气。
lines.en: Three layers of bandage, and I catch my breath.
Treat me, I'm dying!

lines.zh: 胃在抽，谁的罐头分我半罐。
lines.en: My stomach cramps; someone share half a can.
Please heal me!
Hungry, rotting flesh is more appealing.

lines.zh: 这尸体的味道不对，尝尝？
lines.en: This corpse smells off, try it?

lines.zh: 人类的肉更美味，不是吗？
lines.en: Human flesh tastes better, right?
Find more rotting flesh to satiate me!

lines.zh: 尸体里还有生机，慢慢享用。
lines.en: There's life in the corpse, savor it.

lines.zh: 腐肉让我更有力量，吃吧！
lines.en: Rotting flesh gives me strength, eat it!

lines.zh: 寻找更多的腐肉补充我的力量。
lines.en: Seek more rotting flesh to strengthen me.

lines.zh: 腐肉是我唯一的伙伴，分享吧。
lines.en: Rotting flesh is my only companion, share it.

lines.zh: 腐肉中蕴藏力量，吃吧，享受它。
lines.en: Flesh holds power, eat it, savor it.

lines.zh: 腐肉是我的生存之道，永不放弃。
lines.en: Flesh is my way, never give up.

lines.zh: 你撞到我了，该你受苦了。
lines.en: You撞到了me, your suffering begins.
Stay away from me, watch out for zombies.

lines.zh: 我们互相碰撞，你死我活。
lines.en: We collide, you die, I live.

lines.zh: 别撞我，我手里的罐头会掉。
lines.en: Don't bump me; I'll drop my can.
Die with me, you and me.
Collision is your end.
You touched what shouldn't be touched.

lines.zh: 我们的碰撞会给你带来痛苦。
lines.en: Our collision will bring you pain.
Destruction with me is your fate.
You trespassed into my territory.
Explore together, protect each other.

lines.zh: 末日里活下来的人，才配当伴。
lines.en: Only one who survived the end deserves to be my mate.

lines.zh: 和我一起生活，共享腐肉。
lines.en: Live with me, share the flesh.

lines.zh: 和我一起面对末世，生存下去。
lines.en: Face the end with me, survive.
Half my ammo, and do not miss.

lines.zh: 和我一起，寻找新的资源。
lines.en: Find new resources with me.
Reliant on each other, survive.

lines.zh: 和我在一起，你不再孤单。
lines.en: With me, you're not alone.

lines.zh: 我们一起寻找生存的希望。
lines.en: Find hope together.
You are my future mate.

lines.zh: 捡起食物，发出轻微咀嚼声。
lines.en: Munches on the food softly.

lines.zh: 看到掉落的补给，立即扑过去。
lines.en: Snatches up the dropped supplies.

lines.zh: 闻到新鲜尸体的味道，口水流了下来。
lines.en: Saliva drips as it smells fresh flesh.

lines.zh: 从干枯的肢体中捡起一块骨头。
lines.en: Snags a bone from the withered limb.
Chomps on a rotten apple.

lines.zh: 捡起一块人皮包裹的肉。
lines.en: Picks up a meat wrapped in human skin.

lines.zh: 捡起一颗心脏，发出咕噜声。
lines.en: Gulps down a heart, gurgling.

lines.zh: 捡起一只罐头，用力拧开。
lines.en: Forces open a can.

lines.zh: 捡起一把旧剑，擦拭上面的灰尘。
lines.en: Wipes off dust from an old sword.

lines.zh: 捡起一枚戒指，凝视许久。
lines.en: Stares at a ring for a while.

lines.zh: 瞄准了目标，双眼闪烁绿光。
lines.en: Locks onto target, eyes glow green.
Creeps up on the target quietly.

lines.zh: 闻到猎物的气息，迅速锁定。
lines.en: Locks on to prey's scent.
Sibilant hiss at the target.
Emerges quickly at footsteps.

lines.zh: 跟踪目标，保持在视线范围内。
lines.en: Trails target, staying in sight.

lines.zh: 在远处观察目标，慢慢靠近。
lines.en: Observes target from afar, closing in.

lines.zh: 闻到目标的味道，逐渐逼近。
lines.en: Creeps closer, following scent.

lines.zh: 在暗处窥视目标，慢慢靠近。
lines.en: Glimpses target, closing in.
The rifle behind the window is mine.

lines.zh: 别乱动，我枪口抬起来了。
lines.en: Don't move; my muzzle is up.

lines.zh: 你是活人还是那种东西？
lines.en: Are you living, or one of those things?

lines.zh: 把双手放在我看得见的地方。
lines.en: Keep your hands where I can see them.
This block is mine. Understand?

lines.zh: 我只剩三发子弹，别逼我。
lines.en: I have three rounds left. Don't make me.
Lunges at target, hissing.
Grips target, dragging.

lines.zh: 用爪子抓住目标，用力撕咬。
lines.en: Claws target, tearing.

lines.zh: 用利爪划向目标，鲜血直流。
lines.en: Claws target, blood streaming.

lines.zh: 用獠牙咬住目标，用力撕扯。
lines.en: Bites target, tearing.

lines.zh: 用牙齿咬住目标，努力拖走。
lines.en: Bites target, dragging.

lines.zh: 用爪子撕开目标，露出内脏。
lines.en: Tear through target, revealing entrails.

lines.zh: 用牙齿咬住目标，用力撕咬。
lines.en: Bites and tears at target.

lines.zh: 用利爪划破目标，鲜血直流。
lines.en: Claws target, blood streaming.

lines.zh: 你身后那扇门，我先锁了。
lines.en: I already locked the door behind you.
Back to the wall and I'll lower the gun.
I count to three, and you leave.

lines.zh: 丧尸在街上，别开枪引来。
lines.en: The dead are in the street; don't shoot and draw them.
Whatever's in your hands — put it down.
I don't need people. I need bandages.

lines.zh: 我的准星一直对着你胸口。
lines.en: My sights stay on your chest.
Don't point a gun at me; I shoot first.

lines.zh: 这条巷子没第二个出口。
lines.en: This alley has no second exit.

lines.zh: 别怪我，饿极了什么都吃。
lines.en: Don't blame me; starving, I'll eat anything.

lines.zh: 我抓你手腕，先夺下武器。
lines.en: I grab your wrist and take the weapon first.
You can’t escape my attack!
Get a claw in you!
Give me a bite!
You’re just food to me!
You can’t resist my strength!
My fangs will rip you!

lines.zh: 你死定了，尝尝我的利齿！
lines.en: You’re done, taste my fangs!

lines.zh: 我会用我的利爪撕开你！
lines.en: I’ll rip you open with my claws!
My rifle butt cracks your jaw!
My knife goes into your shoulder!
I sidestep and knock your arm aside!
Too close — a gun is clumsier than a blade.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的枪管往边推！
lines.en: I grab your barrel and shove it wide!
My boot connects with the back of your knee!
I emerge from the darkness!

lines.zh: 我抱着罐头，从墙后出来。
lines.en: I come out from behind the wall, clutching a can.
The end begins now!
A new companion in the shadow!

lines.zh: 我从超市废墟里爬出来。
lines.en: I crawl out of the ruined supermarket.
My companions wait!

lines.zh: 黑暗中隐藏着我的身影！
lines.en: I lurk in the darkness!
I’ll defend this land!
The chill of the end is with me!
I am invincible!
I lean out of an abandoned building.
The shelter door opens a crack.

lines.zh: 末世的街上多了个活人。
lines.en: One more living person on the ruined street.
I rack the bolt and walk into the ruins.
In the wasteland, fire is crueler than the dead.

lines.zh: 我从断墙上滑下来，脚崴了。
lines.en: I slid off a broken wall and twisted my ankle.
I was drowned!

lines.zh: 耳朵嗡了，我靠墙躲一下。
lines.en: Ears ringing, I duck against the wall.
The arrow is in my shoulder; I can still move.

lines.zh: 魔法烧过绷带，伤口又开了。
lines.en: Magic burns through my bandage; the wound reopens.

lines.zh: 三天没吃东西，站都站不稳。
lines.en: Three days without food; I can barely stand.
I got struck by lightning!
I fell into the void!
